simpleWatchdogVerdicts.5s: UNSAFE - proven: successful Yumu p95 ~35s visible; a legitimate 5s+ silent-processing call would be killed
simpleWatchdogVerdicts.10s: UNSAFE - same evidence; Kanon ok (n=4 max 5.5s) but Hydrant upstream 100s and LazyBot unbounded
simpleWatchdogVerdicts.15s: UNSAFE - kills Yumu p50/p95 tail and any slow Hydrant upstream
simpleWatchdogVerdicts.30s: UNSAFE - sits at Yumu observed p95 boundary (~35s); one valid success over threshold disproves a hard watchdog

ackOnlyVerdict: UNSAFE today - bridged families never emit receipt-only ACKs; ACK-only traffic is not a defined progress state and cannot safely trigger failure
unrelatedFrameVerdict: UNSAFE - unrelated frames carry no receipt/execution semantics
healthProbeVerdict: CONDITIONALLY_SAFE as a pre-bridge preflight only; it cannot classify in-flight silence (probe success != command execution)
adaptiveTimeoutVerdict: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE - per-family/command n is too small to build distributions
retryReconnectVerdict: UNSAFE for QB-03 - duplicates external work; Kanon dedup makes same-command retry silently useless (QB-02 already removed same-request duplicate bridges)

targetReceiptAckFeasibility.kanon: FEASIBLE - OneBot server has msgAction hook; add one synthetic action frame (e.g. get_status-like or custom action) with echo correlation after message parse
targetReceiptAckFeasibility.yumu: FEASIBLE - Shiro Bot event handler can emit an action frame on receipt; requires target patch
targetReceiptAckFeasibility.hydrant: FEASIBLE - Hydrant command pipeline can CallRawJObjectAsync a receipt action before execution
targetReceiptAckFeasibility.lazybot: FEASIBLE - CommandListener can send a receipt via Bot.sendGroupMsg-like raw action; paused deployment lowers priority

targetExecutionProgressFeasibility.kanon: FEASIBLE with moderate effort (explicit executing frame around command Execute)
targetExecutionProgressFeasibility.yumu: FEASIBLE with moderate effort (service start hooks)
targetExecutionProgressFeasibility.hydrant: FEASIBLE (emit progress action before osu API await)
targetExecutionProgressFeasibility.lazybot: FEASIBLE but low priority while paused

Hydrant osu API up to 100s + Puppeteer screenshot fallback
Yumu osu API retries + 20s render fallback; observed p95 ~35s visible
Kanon Flurl default 100s upstream (IAM/Kagami null-return paths can also be silent)
target event-loop stalls / high load delaying reply frames past a watchdog
legitimate duplicate drop (Kanon dedup / Yumu same-second filter / LazyBot in-flight dedup)
falseNegativeRiskRanking.risk: MEDIUM (false-negative per call, but drop is target-intended)

policies.name: fixed no-frame timeout 5/10/15/20/30s
policies.falseNegativeRisk: VERY HIGH (proven: yumu p95 ~35s; hydrant upstream 100s; lazybot unbounded)
policies.classification: UNSAFE for 5/10/15/20; 30s still kills yumu p95 tail -> UNSAFE

policies.name: family-specific no-frame timeout
policies.falseNegativeRisk: Kanon MEDIUM (n=4 max 5.5s but 100s upstream possible); Yumu HIGH; Hydrant HIGH; LazyBot INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
policies.classification: CONDITIONALLY_SAFE only if family thresholds proven; no family currently has enough evidence

policies.name: command-specific no-frame timeout
policies.falseNegativeRisk: HIGH; per-command latency distributions not measured (recent vs bp vs pplus differ)

policies.name: WS open but zero inbound frames for X seconds
policies.falseNegativeRisk: SAME as P1/P2: legitimate long processing produces zero frames

policies.name: ACK-only for X seconds
policies.falseNegativeRisk: HIGH: ACK-only cannot occur on bridged commands before completion, but a hung target sending only its normal action then slow backend is indistinguishable from receipt; and limiter can delay actions
policies.classification: CONDITIONALLY_SAFE only with target-progress semantics; otherwise UNSAFE

policies.name: unrelated-frame-only for X seconds
policies.falseNegativeRisk: VERY HIGH: unrelated frames are absent during legitimate silence too

policies.name: target health probe before/after bridge
policies.falseNegativeRisk: MEDIUM: probe success != command receipt/execution; probe failure at T0 is useful but bridge itself proves transport
policies.classification: CONDITIONALLY_SAFE as preflight only; not a QB-03 in-flight policy

policies.name: target-side receipt acknowledgement protocol
policies.falseNegativeRisk: LOW once deployed: receipt distinguishes never-received from accepted-but-slow
policies.latencyBenefit: HIGH (fast fail only when target never received)
policies.compatibilityRisk: HIGH (modifies all four bots; old versions need fallback)

policies.name: adaptive timeout based on historical latency
policies.falseNegativeRisk: MEDIUM-HIGH (distributions unknown; cold start; target-side stalls)

policies.name: circuit breaker after repeated silent failures
policies.falseNegativeRisk: LOW per request once opened, but global suppression can mask recovery; no health signal to close reliably
policies.classification: CONDITIONALLY_SAFE with strong evidence; not yet needed

policies.name: one immediate reconnect/retry
policies.falseNegativeRisk: LOW-MEDIUM but duplicates work and Kanon dedup makes retries useless for same command
policies.evidenceQuality: STRONG (P0_2 shows duplicate bridges are the problem)
policies.classification: UNSAFE for QB-03 (duplicate external work; Kanon dedup)
